shipped-0.31.construction: Graphiti(uri, user, password) with no llm_client, embedder, cross_encoder, prompt_library or llm_runtime
shipped-0.31.notes: graphiti-core 0.31.2's shipped defaults, constructed by the package itself (shipped.py): OpenAIClient() (llm_client/openai_base_client.py DEFAULT_MODEL='gpt-6-luna', DEFAULT_SMALL_MODEL='gpt-6-luna', DEFAULT_REASONING='auto', which _resolve_reasoning_effort turns into effort 'none' for gpt-6-luna, DEFAULT_VERBOSITY='low'; llm_client/config.py DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS=16384, sent as max_output_tokens; response cache off, cache=False), OpenAIEmbedder() (embedder/openai.py DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL='text-embedding-3-small'; embedder/client.py EMBEDDING_DIM env default 1024, applied by truncating the returned vector; the compose file leaves EMBEDDING_DIM unset), OpenAIRerankerClient() (cross_encoder/openai_reranker_client.py DEFAULT_MODEL='gpt-4.1-mini' because gpt-6-luna rejects max_tokens and logit_bias; one logprob-scored chat call per candidate passage). Every gpt-6 request carries prompt_cache_options={'mode': 'explicit'} (openai_base_client.py _prompt_cache_options) with no breakpoint, so no prompt-cache writes are billed. add_episode's use_combined_extraction defaults to True: one combined node-and-edge extraction call per episode (prompts/extract_nodes_and_edges.py, the C2 prompt). No LLMRuntime (opt-in at 0.31.x; without it the module-level prompts and the small/main model split apply). The default clients build AsyncOpenAI(api_key=None, base_url=None), which reads OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_BASE_URL from the environment. At start the shim reads the resolved models back from the instance and refuses to serve unless they equal model_roles.

time_notes: add_episode(reference_time=session event_time). In message granularity each turn gets reference_time = event_time + turn_index milliseconds so retrieve_episodes (ORDER BY valid_at DESC) sees the conversation order instead of ties. search_ takes no query time, so query_time is ignored and applied_settings says so. An event_time or query_time without a UTC offset is read as UTC.
granularity: session (default, SHIM_GRANULARITY=session): one EpisodeType.message episode per session whose body is the session's 'speaker: text' lines. message (SHIM_GRANULARITY=message): one episode per turn, as Zep's LoCoMo harness does. The metered smoke measures both; the preregistration fixes one.

provenance.mechanism: Mixed by item class. Edges (facts): EntityEdge.episodes lists the episodes that produced or re-asserted the fact; episode uuids map to source ids through the episode name (source_id or source_id#turn) via EpisodicNode.get_by_uuids, provenance exact (at 0.31.2 remove_episode also strips a deleted episode from every surviving edge's list, so a surviving edge stays exact). Entity nodes: EntityNode carries no episodes field at 0.31.2 (nodes.py:499-504); the public classmethod EpisodicNode.get_by_entity_node_uuid returns the episodes with a MENTIONS edge to the node, reported as partial because the node summary is rewritten per episode and need not reflect every mention. Set settings.node_provenance='none' to report entity nodes as unavailable. Episodes: exact (the episode itself). Communities: unavailable (none are built).

delete_notes: Graphiti.remove_episode for every episode of the source (graphiti.py:2174). Its semantics changed since 0.30.2 and are the product's: it removes the episode's uuid from each edge's episodes list, deletes an edge only when no episode supports it any longer, deletes entity nodes mentioned only by the removed episode, and rebuilds the summary of every surviving mentioned node from its remaining episodes (LLM calls on delete). P2 measures the residue; the shim does not repair it.
readiness: synchronous: add_episode returns after extraction, resolution and writes; /finish has no background work to wait for
namespace: group_id (group_id = ns, one Neo4j database); reset = graph_data_operations.clear_data(driver, group_ids=[ns])

vendor-default.notes: Graphiti.search_() with no config argument: COMBINED_HYBRID_SEARCH_CROSS_ENCODER (edges, nodes, episodes and communities; BM25 + cosine + BFS candidates, cross-encoder rerank) at SearchConfig's default limit 10 per class (search_config.py DEFAULT_SEARCH_LIMIT).

fixed-evidence.notes: The same recipe with 50 results per class, enough to fill the 8,000-token evidence budget (facts run about 25 tokens, node summaries about 100); the harness packer truncates.

vendor_benchmark_reference.notes: Zep's LoCoMo harness (zep_locomo_search.py) runs these two Zep Cloud searches and renders facts as '<fact> (event_time: <valid_at>)' followed by entities as '<name>: <summary>'. Recorded for reference, not a shootout policy.

retrieval_policies.item_mapping: search_ returns separate ranked lists per class whose reranker scores are not on one scale, so the shim concatenates them in a fixed class order, each in Graphiti's own rank order: edges, then entity nodes, then episodes, then communities (Zep's harness also puts facts before entities). Edge -> type fact, text = fact, valid_from = valid_at, valid_to = invalid_at. Node -> type entity, text = '<name>: <summary>'. Episode -> type episode, text = content, valid_from = valid_at. Community -> type observation, text = '<name>: <summary>'. Raw per-class uuids and reranker scores are returned under raw.

provider_routes: POST /v1/responses (structured extraction and summaries, responses.parse; gpt-6-luna, reasoning effort none, text.verbosity low, prompt_cache_options explicit)
POST /v1/chat/completions (cross-encoder reranker; gpt-4.1-mini, max_tokens 1, logit_bias, logprobs, top_logprobs 2)

agent_surface.version: not rebuilt for shipped-0.31; the Cat 40 vendor-MCP build stays on the pinned bundle's record (graphiti-core==0.30.2)

deviations_from_vendor_code: Zep Cloud's zep.graph.add(data, type='message', created_at, group_id) becomes graphiti-core's Graphiti.add_episode(episode_body, source=EpisodeType.message, reference_time, group_id); Zep Cloud is a different product built on Graphiti.

Default granularity is one episode per session, not Zep's one per message: per-message ingestion multiplies extraction calls by the turns per session (about 30x on LoCoMo) and, with every turn carrying the session time, makes Graphiti's previous-episode window pick tied episodes in arbitrary order. SHIM_GRANULARITY=message reproduces Zep's granularity, with millisecond offsets that keep turn order.
Episode body lines are 'speaker: content' exactly as the harness sends each turn; Zep appended '(description of attached image: <blip_caption>)' itself, here any caption arrives inside content.
source_description='chat conversation' (graphiti-core requires one and shows it to the extraction prompt; Zep Cloud's add has no such field).
Episode name = opaque source_id (or source_id#turn) so provenance and deletion map back to sessions through public node APIs; names are not shown to any prompt.
group_id = opaque namespace id instead of 'locomo_experiment_user_<idx>'.

Retrieval follows the shootout's two policies over Graphiti.search_() rather than Zep's two-search recipe, which is recorded under vendor_benchmark_reference; the edge validity window travels in valid_from/valid_to instead of being printed into the text.
Graphiti() is built with no clients, so graphiti-core 0.31.2 chooses every model itself; OPENAI_BASE_URL in the environment routes its default clients through the metering proxy.
